verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents guarded rollouts as a first-party feature: traffic to the new variation increases progressively while selected metrics are monitored for regressions. That covers the metric guard and regression detection. The evidence never states that a detected regression triggers an automatic rollback; the only rollback shown is a manual one via change history. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of automatic rollback on regression, detail on configuring regression thresholds, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can guard a rollout with metrics so a regression is detected and the release is rolled back automatically

citations.quote: A guarded rollout progressively increases traffic to the new variation while monitoring selected metrics for regressions
You can also use the change history to roll back a flag
